title: Evaluating Generative AI Systems is a Social Science Measurement Challenge

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual critique and meta-evaluation of existing benchmark datasets (e.g., StereoSet, CrowS-Pairs) using a four-level social science measurement framework to analyze their lack of explicit conceptual systematization.
Theoretical analysis using measurement theory to illustrate how differing definitions of demeaning text and hate speech must be explicitly systematized before operationalization via ML classifiers.
